rows.text: You are deep in a dense forest, an ancient temple entangled in vines looming before you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A bouquet blooms from Mnestia's golden chrysalis, statues faded to alabaster white, poets surrounded by flitting butterflies, their bodies leaned against the edge of the stone steps, gently caressing the strings of their lyres.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I have heard your sorrow, the ends of the westerly winds, tears intertwining like flowing streams. I sing a song of your love, upon Styxia's shores."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Their gazes fall from the ends of your hair, waiting for you to open your eyes once more, where only a few butterflies with iridescent wings are left.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I have to chase after them." Your heart yells out in desire.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Pursue the butterfly that sniffs out bygone memories.
The obtained Curio will be Occurrence-Domain-related
It extols the weave of a single golden thread, shedding its olden divine form, embarking on a journey in search of love.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Pursue the butterfly that flies across the battlefield.
The obtained Curio will be Combat-Domain-related
It mourns the fall of a Kremnoan king, a heroic and prideful warrior, caught and dragged beneath the wheels of an enemy chariot.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Pursue the butterfly on the hero's shoulder.
The obtained Curio will be Encounter-Domain-related
It whispers of a reminiscent taste of honey brew, pursuing glorious heroes raising their goblets in merriment over swaying seas.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Pursue the butterfly you chanced upon.
The obtained Curio will be Wealth-Domain-related
It awaits a reunion that will never arrive, a time scintillating in gold, when poets encountered the Chrysalis of Gold's kin.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
